items.title: Man arrested after beheading Iwo Jima statue in Virginia with sledgehammer
items.brief: The Battle of Iwo Jima monument in Quantico, Virginia, has suffered hundreds of thousands of dollars in damages after a man beheaded one of the statues Wednesday evening, police said.

items.title: Why Zelensky insists it’s not personal with Trump — even though it is
items.brief: Volodymyr Zelensky told CNN on Thursday that there’s “not something personal” driving his latest estrangement from President Donald Trump.

items.title: France reports first human case of livestock virus Shamonda after patient dies
items.brief: France reported the first human case of the Shamonda virus usually found in livestock on Thursday in a hospital patient who died, though authorities said there was no risk to the general population.

items.title: Top Trump political advisers donate fee for work on behalf of pro-Russian government after he floated firing them
items.brief: Top Trump political advisers James Blair and Chris LaCivita have donated money they made earlier this month in the Balkans on behalf of a pro-Russian government to President Donald Trump’s presidential library.

items.title: 7-magnitude earthquake hits Tibet, killing 16 and injuring dozens, Chinese state media reports
items.brief: At least 16 people have died and dozens were injured after a magnitude 7 earthquake struck Tibet on Thursday, according to Chinese state news agency Xinhua.
